response.justification: While Bogdan is an accomplished software engineer with 14+ years of experience meeting the educational requirement (Bachelor's + 8+ years), this principal-level role requires specialized expertise entirely absent from his background. The position demands SoC and IP modeling, GPU architecture knowledge, and deep learning workload optimization—areas where he has no demonstrated experience. His career has been focused on full-stack software engineering, web development, and mobile applications, not hardware architecture or AI accelerator optimization. The domain gap is too significant for a principal-level hire.
strengths: Meets educational requirement with Bachelor's degree plus 14+ years of relevant technical experience
Proven ability to optimize performance-critical systems, including low-latency microservices and high-throughput data processing
Some hardware exposure through robotic arm development and measurement software, plus cloud infrastructure experience with AWS and Kubernetes
concerns: No experience with SoC and IP modeling, which are explicitly listed as required skills for the role
Lacks GPU architecture, AI accelerator design, and deep learning workload optimization expertise—core responsibilities of this position
Background is entirely in software engineering and full-stack development; no evidence of hardware-level systems architecture or hardware-software co-design work

key_factors.factor: Missing AI accelerator and hardware optimization expertise
